items.question: Who is ADA – Travel Agency Tarko?
items.answer: ADA – Travel Agency Tarko is an Albanian tour operator based in Tirana with more than 15 years of experience. We specialise in cycling tours, group bus tours, and customised travel experiences across Albania and the Western Balkans. We work closely with travel partners in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland to deliver unforgettable journeys.

items.question: What types of tours do you offer?
Can I travel individually?
items.answer: Yes. Whether you're travelling alone, as a couple, or with a small group, we provide personalised support before and throughout your journey.

items.question: Do you provide local support?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our local team in Albania is available to assist you before your arrival and throughout your stay.

items.question: Which countries do you operate in?
Who are your travel partners?
items.answer: We have long-standing partnerships with travel agencies and organisations in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland that have been offering our cycling, hiking, and bus tours for many years.

items.question: Where can I learn more about your company?
items.answer: Visit our website for complete information about our tours and services.

homeAboutAlbania.body1: Discover one of Europe's most exciting hidden destinations.
homeAboutAlbania.body2: Located between the Adriatic and Ionian Seas, Albania offers a remarkable combination of pristine beaches, dramatic mountains, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, historic towns, and authentic Mediterranean culture.

8-day-cycling.title: 8-Day Cycling & Discovery Tour Through Albania (2026)
8-day-cycling.quickDescription: Discover Albania, often called the "Last Secret of Europe," on an unforgettable guided cycling adventure. Ride through mountain passes, UNESCO World Heritage cities, breathtaking coastlines, and picturesque valleys while experiencing authentic Albanian culture and hospitality.
8-day-cycling.quickDescriptionAudience: Suitable for couples, families, friends, solo travelers, and small groups.
8-day-cycling.aboutBody: Experience an eight-day guided cycling journey across Albania covering approximately 350 km through mountains, valleys, lakes, and the stunning Ionian and Adriatic coastlines. The route combines scenic cycling, cultural exploration, UNESCO heritage sites, and comfortable hotel stays, making it ideal for travelers with a moderate level of fitness.

8-day-albania-montenegro.quickDescription: Experience the breathtaking landscapes of Albania and Montenegro on an unforgettable cycling adventure through the Balkans. Ride across mountain passes, crystal-clear lakes, alpine valleys, and charming villages while enjoying local hospitality, scenic boat rides, and hiking in the spectacular Albanian Alps.

8-day-albania-montenegro.aboutBody: This 8-day guided cycling and adventure tour combines cycling, hiking, and boating across Albania and Montenegro. Explore the Albanian Alps, Lake Skadar, the Valbona Valley, and remote Balkan villages while covering scenic routes through mountains, rivers, and lakes. The tour is designed for travelers with a moderate fitness level and is supported by a luggage transfer vehicle throughout the journey.

9-day-vjosa-valley.title: ADA – 9-Day Astrid Cycling Tour, Vjosa Valley (2027)
9-day-vjosa-valley.quickDescription: Discover the "last secret of Europe" by bicycle. A 9-day cycling and adventure tour through Albania's Vjosa Valley, from Lake Ohrid to the Ionian and Adriatic coasts.
9-day-vjosa-valley.quickDescriptionAudience: For singles, couples, families, or friends.
9-day-vjosa-valley.aboutBody: Albania, the "sunshine country of Europe," is a wonderful holiday paradise on the west coast of the Balkans. Immerse yourself in the land of the Skipetars, as Albanians like to call themselves — a country that played a significant role in the Balkans' past, was then largely forgotten, and is now seeking and finding its way back to Europe. The many architecturally unique mountain ranges, gorges, rivers, and valleys, as well as the UNESCO-protected cities and buildings, speak of this country's eventful history. Our cycling tour takes you along Lake Ohrid, through the dramatic southern highlands and the Vjosa river valley, along the rugged Ionian coast, past Caesar's Pass, and into Vlora Bay in the southern Adriatic with its rocky and pine-forest coast.

tourInfo.value: Mostly paved, lightly trafficked secondary roads

highlights: 50 km cycling around Lake Ohrid, the deepest lake in Europe
200 km south through the mountains and the Vjosa Valley, over passes and through forests
150 km along the Ionian Sea Riviera through small bays, olive groves, and cypress trees
Caesar (Logara) Pass and Vlora Bay via small roads through spectacular mountains
3 UNESCO World Heritage cities to explore on foot
Coastal hotels on the Ionian and Adriatic Seas with Mediterranean flair
Traditional Mediterranean cuisine featuring fish, wine, lemons, and olive oil
importantNotes: Program is subject to change.
Moderately challenging cycling stages through mountains and river valleys along the hilly and flat Riviera coast.
Cycling mainly on paved, lightly trafficked secondary roads.
Increased traffic expected at city entrances.
Some cycling days exceed 1,000 m elevation gain.
Support vehicle available during selected uphill sections.

15-day-west-balkans.title: 15-Day West Balkans Cycling Tour: Croatia – Montenegro – Albania – Macedonia – Corfu
15-day-west-balkans.quickDescription: This guided cycling tour leaves nothing to be desired for cycling adventurers and explorers of uncharted territory. In 15 days, cycle along the Adriatic coast from Dubrovnik through Montenegro and Albania to North Macedonia, then on to the Greek island of Corfu — far removed from the usual tourist routes.
15-day-west-balkans.quickDescriptionAudience: For experienced group travelers seeking a longer, cross-border cycling adventure through the Western Balkans.
15-day-west-balkans.aboutBody: Discover venerable ancient buildings, now recognized as UNESCO World Heritage Sites, bizarre and almost deserted landscapes, and the vibrant life of southeastern European cities, experiencing the warmth and hospitality of the locals firsthand. Each evening brings a highlight of local cuisine and culinary delights. This extended 15-day journey links five countries by bicycle, boat, and coach: Croatia's Dalmatian coast, the Bay of Kotor and Lake Skadar in Montenegro, the Albanian Riviera and Vjosa Valley, Lake Ohrid on the Albania–Macedonia border, and a final ferry crossing to the Greek island of Corfu.

10-day-vjosa-river-tour.quickDescription: Discover the "last secret of Europe" by bicycle. A 10-day cycling and hiking adventure along Albania's Vjosa River, from Lake Ohrid to the Ionian Riviera, the Benje thermal baths, and the ancient ruins of Apollonia and Berat.
10-day-vjosa-river-tour.quickDescriptionAudience: For singles, couples, families, or friends.
10-day-vjosa-river-tour.aboutBody: Albania, the "sunshine country of Europe," is a wonderful holiday paradise on the west coast of the Balkans. Immerse yourself in the land of the Skipetars, as Albanians like to call themselves — a country that played a significant role in the Balkans' past, was then largely forgotten, and is now seeking and finding its way back to Europe. The many architecturally unique mountain ranges, gorges, rivers, and valleys, as well as the UNESCO-protected cities and buildings, speak of this country's eventful history. Our cycling tour takes you along the flat Adriatic coast, 250 km in length, and the 200 km long southern Ionian coast — the wild and beautiful Riviera will make this tour unforgettable. The route follows Lake Ohrid, the dramatic southern highlands, the rugged Ionian coast, Caesar's Pass, and Vlora Bay in the southern Adriatic with its rocky, pine-forest coastline.
